kael_intro.speaker: kael
kael_intro.text: Psst! Mistress Elorin! Over here behind the cargo barrels. You know how the water level in Canal Three has been dropping two inches every night? It's not evaporation. Someone's tapped a siphon into the main conduit under Lock Seven.

start_quest.title: The Smuggler's Siphon
start_quest.desc: Track down an illegal star-water siphon draining celestial essence from the Canal Quarter locks.
stages: Meet Dockhand Kael at the lower canal sluice
Trace the hidden siphon conduits beneath the docks
Decide the fate of the black-market essence ring

choices.text: [Acumen Check] Star-water contains refined celestial essence. Someone is distilling it for black-market alchemy in the Under-Terraces.
Who runs the barges through Lock Seven at night, Kael?
Show me where the siphon attaches to the lock mechanism.

kael_explain.speaker: kael
kael_explain.text: It's the Silver Current syndicate. They bottle the concentrate and sell it to uncredited scholars who can't get Academy lab permits.

choices.text: Lead me to their tapping point.

kael_acumen_pass.speaker: kael
kael_acumen_pass.text: Spot on. They've rigged brass pipes directly into the sluice valve. If the water pressure drops too low, the hydraulic lift for the hospital barges will stall.

choices.text: We must disconnect the siphon and secure the valve.

kael_action.speaker: kael
kael_action.text: There! See that flexible lead tubing running under the wharf? They've got three casks filling right now.

choices.text: Sever the siphon line and seal the lock breach.

kael_resolve.speaker: kael
kael_resolve.text: Valve sealed and lines confiscated! The lock water is already rising back to full mark. The canal folk will breathe a lot easier tonight, Mistress.
